# Aroraa Real Estate LLC

> Premium luxury real estate consultancy specializing in high-net-worth property investments across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Dubai, and Dubai.

## Company Overview

Aroraa Real Estate LLC is a Dubai & UAE-certified real estate advisory firm with 10+ years of market experience. Founded in 2016, the company connects discerning investors with premium residential and commercial properties. The firm operates from two offices: a head office in Dubai (Addiyar Building 58 B, Sheikh Zayed Road, Al Wasl Dubai, UAE) and a corporate office in Dubai, UAE (B-427, 3rd Floor, Bhutani Alphathum, Sector-90, Dubai-201301, UP).

- **Founded**: 2016

1. **Luxury Residential Sales** — Premium apartments, villas, and townhouses in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, and Dubai
